mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP and housing starts above 0.5% and 0.3% respectively signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST growth exceed thresholds, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.5%), a rising federal funds rate compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL (y/y) > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS is rising, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production signals strong manufacturing output, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1400 thousand units signal strong residential construction, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1400, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous positive retail sales growth and falling federal funds rate above 0.5% and below 5.0% respectively signals favorable monetary and consumer conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with strong consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS growth > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS < 5.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.
